spec_ref: owed_test_plan_v1_2_untested.md K13 (first decision: does near-contract-standards link on protocol 86?)

measurements.built_with: RUSTFLAGS="--cfg near" cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release (a minimal NFT contract with nft_transfer_call, approvals and enumeration)

observations: ANSWER: the standards crate does NOT link on mainnet protocol 86. The macros need the near-sdk Promise and PromiseOrValue types, and a contract that uses them imports gas-key and universal-state host functions that protocol 86 lacks (same cause as K1 and K4). NEP-171, 177, 178 and 181 therefore stay hand-written on env::promise_* (as in k13, which links clean and passes on mainnet). This replaces the earlier prediction with a measurement
the crate was downloaded by the human's approval into a scratch folder outside the project; it was built there only to read the wasm imports
caveat: the answer is for near-sdk and near-contract-standards 5.30.0; a later release that avoids the Promise type would change it, so re-run the import check on any upgrade
